def neg_sharpe(w, mu, Sigma, rf):
    ret = w @ mu - rf
    vol = np.sqrt(w @ Sigma @ w)
    return -ret / vol

res = minimize(neg_sharpe, x0=np.ones(n)/n,
    args=(mu, Sigma, rf), jac=neg_sharpe_grad,
    constraints=[cons], bounds=bounds,
    method="SLSQP")
caption: Supplying jac avoids slow, noisy finite-difference gradients.

Guarding against a bad local optimum

best = None
for _ in range(20):
    x0 = rng.dirichlet(np.ones(n))
    r = minimize(neg_sharpe, x0, args=(mu, Sigma, rf),
        constraints=[cons], bounds=bounds, method="SLSQP")
    if best is None or r.fun < best.fun:
        best = r
caption: Multi-start optimization checks that the result isn't a local artifact.
